softens into a smile. She looks toward her mother, who smiles back. The camera pulls out with small amplitude
at slow speed, gently widening the shared view while their bodies and the tabletop arrangement stay settled.
The shot ends on their exchanged smiles, with both desserts still on the table and the candle wick dark.
